kurz: Baking powder is baking soda with built-in acid and a little starch. Most kinds react once when mixed and again in the heat of the oven.
bild_im_kopf: Like sherbet powder with a time fuse.
was_passiert: The starch keeps [[natron|baking soda]] and acid dry and apart. With liquid the first reaction starts; the second acid only reacts with heat. Old or damply stored baking powder loses its power.
faustregeln: Test: a teaspoon in hot water must fizz vigorously.

rolle.rolle: makes more gas in the heat
